text:
Rae: Quick notes from the model-catalog review just now. Putting everything here so it's searchable.

Diego: Thanks. Main pain pts we saw: sticky filter bar overlaps compare table header at small widths, badge color hierarchy is confusing, and pin state isn't discoverable in list view.

Priya: For the sticky filters: can we collapse them into a single compact row when viewport < 900px? Right now it pushes the table down and hides the column headers.

Nora: Dev note: collapsing is fine but we must keep filter keyboard access. A toggle button that expands filters would need aria-expanded states.

Jun: Accessibility nit: when the filter bar is collapsed, screen readers should still be able to reach filter controls via a skip link. Suggest: "Skip to filter" at top of page.

Rae: Good call. Also UX: when users enter compare mode, we currently overlay a floating toolbar. It covers the leftmost column actions. Maybe shift the toolbar to top-right or make it detachable.

Diego: Top-right seems less invasive. If detachable, allow keyboard users to move focus to the toolbar with `t` shortcut (proposal).

Priya: Love the `t` shortcut idea. Add a tooltip to mention keyboard shortcuts the first time someone uses compare mode.

Nora: Badge contrast: the yellow 'fast' badge on light backgrounds fails WCAG AA for text. Either darken text or add a subtle outline.

Jun: Also badges need machine-readable labels for SRs: `aria-label="Performance: optimized for latency"`. Not just visual.

Rae: For compare table columns: suggestion to pin the model name column so horizontal scroll keeps identity visible. Thoughts?

Diego: Pin column good, but it interacts badly with small screens. Maybe only pin when table width > 1100px, otherwise stack name above metrics in a compact card row.

Priya: On version pinning: current UI uses a faint pin icon next to version. Users missed it in testing. Proposal: promote pin to a small inline toggle with text on hover and add `aria-pressed` for SR.

Nora: And add a simple success toast: "Version pinned — showing in your saved views" with an undo. That helps discoverability.

Jun: Exportability: product asked to allow exporting pinned sets as JSON for rollouts. Backend will need an endpoint. Diego, can you note in spec?

Diego: Noted. I'll add `POST /users/:id/pinned-versions` to spec. Also include response shape example: `{ "pinned": ["model:a@v1"] }` in docs.

Rae: Copy tweak for badge tooltip: instead of "Low latency" use "Low latency — ideal for real-time features". Short and action-oriented.

Priya: Agree. For the compare legend, add an inline key: small grey pill that maps badge colors to meanings. Helps new users.

Nora: Keyboard flow: when entering compare mode, focus should land on the first compare checkbox. Current behavior keeps focus in the search box. That's confusing.

Jun: Also table row density: designers want a compact mode and dense mode. Dense mode must still maintain 24px target for interactive elements. We can't go below.

Rae: UX decision: keep dense visual spacing but enforce 24px targets for checkboxes/links. Designers to mock with invisible padding.

Diego: For mobile: compare grid becomes stacked cards; badges move below the name and pin becomes full-width button. We'll need responsive breakpoints in the spec.

Priya: Accessibility QA: add tests for badge `aria-label`, pin `aria-pressed`, filter toggle `aria-expanded`, and keyboard shortcut `t` focus handling.

Nora: I'll author those test cases. Also add a unit test for the sticky filter not overlapping headers at 320-768px.

design-bot: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/abc-model-catalog/compare-ux (frame: responsive-sticky-filters)

Rae: Action items: (1) Design: compact filter row + badge legend (Priya). (2) FE: `t` shortcut + column pin logic + 24px hit targets (Diego). (3) QA: accessibility tests + responsive overlap test (Nora). (4) PM: add export endpoint to API spec (Diego).

Priya: I'll push the mock updates by EOD and add notes about invisible hit padding.

Diego: I'll prototype the `t` shortcut and open a draft PR with keyboard handling. ETA 4d.

Nora: I'll start writing test cases and ping once they're in TestRail.

Rae: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after mocks land. :sparkles:
